Hi all — technical note on log export and what we can provide for the 30-day sample: 

• Log types: access logs (API gateway), inference request logs (redacted user payloads), auth events, and system audit events.
• Redaction: PII and PHI are removed server-side using our redaction pipeline before export. We can provide a short readme describing regex rules and fields removed.
• Delivery: time-limited S3 presigned URL (recommended) or SFTP if required by policy.
• Size & sampling: 30 calendar days typically yields ~4–12 GB depending on traffic. We can pre-filter to only requests hitting your tenant ID to reduce size.

Attached is a runbook (log-export-runbook.md) with commands we’ll run to create the sample and the expected file manifest.

If the security team prefers, we can do the demo first and then deliver the link immediately after the session.

Thanks —
